title: Membrane Arena 3x3 + Yin-Yang Shield: a 3x3 lattice of density-matrix cells with an observer and a calibrator (SYNTHETIC classical simulation)
description: SYNTHETIC classical simulation in Python and NumPy of a 3x3 lattice of 32-dimensional density-matrix cells with a read-only observer, a bounded calibrator, transactional all-or-nothing updates and a circuit breaker. 'Holographic universe', 'Yin', 'Yang' and 'Schumann' are names only; the 7.83 Hz signal is an arbitrary sinusoid with no physical claim. Not quantum hardware and not a control system. The README documents measured behavior and known limits, including that the default settings latch the breaker after about 8 steps. A separate project from the membrane-arena browser game.
